# Space Pilates + Wellness Society

> Boutique mat Pilates and wellness studio in Historic Downtown Sanford, Florida. Four class formats (classical mat Pilates, Sculpt, Strength, restorative Yoga), small classes of up to 15, founded by Carey Caratini, a Pilates instructor, NASM certified personal trainer and licensed mental health therapist.

- Address: 307 E 2nd St, Sanford, FL 32771 (Historic Downtown Sanford)
- Phone: (321) 249-2262
- Email: hi@spacepilatesandwellness.com
- Serves: Sanford, Lake Mary, Heathrow, Longwood
- New member offer: 2 weeks of unlimited classes for $69
- Prices: drop-in $29; 10 class pack $230; memberships $89/month (4 classes), $149/month (8 classes), $199/month (unlimited); month to month, no contract
- Schedule: weekday classes from 6:00 AM to 6:30 PM, plus Saturday and Sunday mornings
- Booking: Mariana Tek, on the website and the Space Pilates & Wellness app (iOS and Android)
